**Does a non-PSU guest need a membership or national ID?**

Several recorded policy versions have unresolved scope or conditions. Each source is retained; confirm the applicable version with the studio.
Do I need to become a member first?: Membership is not required to use the studio. [S1]
You do not need to be a PSU student. The published booking steps do not specify a separate membership sign-up. Visitors use the National ID field and present a national ID card at check-in; fees depend on the user group and service. [S2]
The policy validity interval is unconfirmed. The recorded clause does not establish current permission.
